    Idempotent corners of representation-finite algebras #

    Lemma 3.1(1), second part (projective-rays.tex): for C = eAe, the extension of C-modules to A-modules is fully faithful and preserves finite dimension, indecomposability and isomorphism classes; hence C is representation-finite. The source uses induction V ↦ V ⊗_C eA, whose unit V → (V ⊗_C eA)e is an isomorphism. We use the adjoint form, coinduction V ↦ Hom_C(Ae, V), whose counit Hom_C(Ae, V)e → V is an isomorphism; this avoids tensor products over the noncommutative ring C.
